moveHint: Move them to a course, or to My notes
mineEmpty: Everything you make lands here first. Drag it onto a course when it belongs to one.
courseEmpty: Nothing filed here yet. Drag a note onto this course, or press + for a page in it.
indexIntro: Everything you write, draw, upload or record. New notes start in My notes; put one in a course when you want to, from its header or by dragging it in the sidebar.
emptyBody: Pages, whiteboards, files, links, recordings and photos all live here, and start in My notes. Made during a class, a note asks once whether it belongs to that course. In the sidebar they're a tree: drag one onto a page to put it inside, or onto a course to file it there.
inMineNested: In My notes, inside a page
inCourseHint: In {course}: open it, or move this to another course
inMineHint: In My notes: move it to a course
name: Name
savedAsYouGo: Every change is saved as you go
moveManyDesc: They go to the top of that list, with anything inside them.
moveOneDesc: It goes to the top of that list, with anything inside it.
keepInMine: Keep it in My notes, and don't ask again
madeDuring: Made during {session}. File it in {course}, under that class.
madeWith: Made with {course} open. File it there.
noMatch: No note has those words. Search looks at titles and the text you’ve written.
allFiled: Every note is already in a course. New notes start in My notes, and show up here to be added.
noNotesYet: No notes yet. Pages, whiteboards, files and links you make in Notes show up here.
fromDriveHint: Pick files or a folder; Docs come in as PDF
badLink: That doesn’t look like a link. Try one that starts with https://
goesInMine: Goes in My notes. Move it to a course any time.
newNoteHint: {name}: a page, a whiteboard, a file, a link…
tileLectureHint: Main ideas, an example, exam hints
notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it's on a device that hasn't synced yet.
onDevice: This recording is kept on the computer that made it. Open it there, in the BiliMind app.
cantOpen: It can’t be opened right now. Try again when you’re online.
backWhere: It is back where it was.
insidePages: And the page inside. | And the {n} pages inside.
couldntMakeBody: Check the connection and try again.
typePageHint: Type it up: notes, a plan, a summary
typeBoardHint: Draw it out, stick notes, connect ideas
typeUploadHint: PDFs, slides, documents, one or many
typeLinkHint: An article, a video, a site to come back to
typeRecordHint: A lecture, a seminar or a thought out loud
typeScreenHint: Slides, a board or a demo, with your voice; kept on this computer
typePhotoHint: The board, a slide, a page of a book
typeNotionHint: Your pages, and assignments as deadlines to check
typeDraftHint: Say what it’s about; BiliMind writes a first version
